All the teachers and staff are fantastic. Very friendly and polite. Big smiles every morning. A very positive atmosphere at the school and this is totally down to the great team.
My child loves going to school and always speaks highly of his teacher, TA and all the staff at Willow bank.
This is a school where staff are committed to get families what they need in order to improve opportunities, raise aspirations and live a meaningful, happy life. In short, this is a school that changes lives for the better.
Pupils were able to talk knowledgably about the school Vision and Values. It was clear that they had relevance and that the children understood how the school was shaping them as individuals.
Thank you so much for giving me the opportunity to visit Willow Bank. Everyone was very welcoming. Your learning environments are beautiful. Your children are a credit to you, happy to share their positive experiences which all comes from great teaching.
It was wonderful to see how well routines such as talk partners are so well established. Also brilliant to hear how real-life, meaningful experiences are incorporated across units of work. Your children are confident, safe, creative and joyful. Thank you!
Welcoming, kind, friendly staff. Lovely atmosphere when walking around the school. Children I spoke to were very polite, happy to share their learning and able to talk about their learning well.
It is a school that has a clear vision. We have taken away lots from our visit.
You should all be very proud of all you have achieved over the last few years.
Willow Bank Primary School, Seacourt Road, London, SE2 9XB

pageCache.pageTitle: Ethos and Values - Willow Bank Primary School
pageCache.text:
Ethos and Values
We believe that our core values are central to building positive relationships and excellent learning behaviours within our school community and stakeholders.
Our values: respect, integrity, kindness, resilience, aspiration, and curiosity were developed collaboratively with our families and staff to ensure our whole community has ownership and they permeate every interaction and aspect of daily school life.
Our children and staff model our values as we believe they establish the foundations which enable our children to become positive global citizens, contributing to their own and society’s well-being well beyond their primary education.
Willow Bank Primary School, Seacourt Road, London, SE2 9XB

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Headteacher - Willow Bank Primary School
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Headteacher
At Willow Bank Primary School, our children are at the heart of every decision we make. We are committed to helping every child thrive academically, socially and emotionally within a caring, inclusive and ambitious school community. By working in close partnership with families, we create an environment where children feel safe, valued and inspired to achieve their very best.
We are proud of the vibrant community we serve and believe that every child should leave Willow Bank with the confidence, knowledge and skills to embrace the opportunities ahead. Our core values of Respect, Integrity, Kindness, Resilience, Aspiration and Curiosity are woven throughout school life, shaping our curriculum, our relationships and the experiences we provide for every child. Together, these values help our children become confident, compassionate and resilient young people who are ready for the next stage of their education and beyond.
We are proud that our recent Ofsted inspection recognised the positive culture across Willow Bank Primary School, where pupils feel safe, enjoy learning and are proud to be part of our close-knit school community. Inspectors also recognised the school's high ambitions for every child and the inclusive support that enables pupils to achieve well.
Whether you are considering Willow Bank Primary School for your child or simply finding out more about us, I hope our website gives you a glimpse into life at our school. If you would like to discover more, we warmly welcome visits and would be delighted to show you around. You can also explore our Why Choose Willow Bank Primary School page to discover what makes Willow Bank such a special place to learn and grow.
Thank you for taking the time to visit our website. I look forward to welcoming you to Willow Bank Primary School.
Willow Bank Primary School, Seacourt Road, London, SE2 9XB

pageCache.pageTitle: PTFA and Volunteering - Willow Bank Primary School
pageCache.text:
PTFA and Volunteering
At Willow Bank Primary School, we believe that strong, effective relationships with parents and carers is in the best interests of our children. We understand that our parents and carers know their child best; what engages and motivates them, their strengths, passions and interests. By combining parents’ knowledge of their child with staff’s expertise in teaching and learning, we can ensure the best outcomes for our children.
Our school values the relationship it holds with the whole school community, and actively seeks to provide opportunities for these relationships to flourish. We seek to involve parents and carers in their children’s learning and education by sharing information about the curriculum that they are participating in. As part of the curriculum philosophy, parents and carers are invited to help celebrate a new topic by preparing for Big Bang Days, sharing a curriculum overview which sets out a term’s learning and, ending in a celebration of learning whereby parents and carers are invited into the school for termly Sharing Assemblies.
We encourage parents and carers to tell us what support they feel they need and aim to provide information, whether through our newsletter, curriculum overviews or workshops. Furthermore, parent consultation evenings provide an opportunity for parents and carers to learn more about their child/ren’s social/emotional and learning progress throughout the academic year.
Our school is very fortunate to have a dedicated, enthusiastic and tireless PTFA who are current parents and carers of children in our school. Friends of Willow Bank work in partnership with the Headship Team and our Community Liaison Officer, to raise funds to support the school. The funds are used to enhance all the children's educational experiences by financing additional programmes and equipment.
Friends of Willow Bank host fundraising events and initiatives throughout the school year, the proceeds of which are reinvested back into Willow Bank Primary School. All our events and initiatives are made possible by parent volunteers.
Our PTFA have a dedicated website page, Click here to visit and find out more them and about how you can support.
You can also follow them on Facebook for news and updates- click here to see their page and give them a follow!
We welcome parents and carers who may wish to further support our children more widely by providing regular support in the classroom, for example with reading or learning activities. We value particular knowledge, skills or expertise that many parents can provide to the benefit of our children, further broadening their experiences and aspirations.
If you would like to volunteer your time, please do contact the school office and speak to our Community Liaison Officer.
Willow Bank Primary School, Seacourt Road, London, SE2 9XB
